drivingQuestion: Why does ma'amad u'moshav, not a matter of sanctity, need ten?

segments.he: וְאֵין עוֹשִׂין מַעֲמָד וּמוֹשָׁב פָּחוֹת מֵעֲשָׂרָה. כֵּיוָן דְּבָעֵי לְמֵימַר: ״עִמְדוּ יְקָרִים עֲמוֹדוּ, שְׁבוּ יְקָרִים שֵׁבוּ״ — בְּצִיר מֵעֲשָׂרָה לָאו אוֹרַח אַרְעָא.
segments.en: § We learned in the mishna: «And one does not observe» the practice of «standing up and sitting down» for the delivery of eulogies at a funeral service «with fewer than ten» men present. As this is not an expression of sanctity, it is therefore necessary to explain why a quorum is required. The Gemara explains: «Since» the leader of the funeral procession «is required to say: Stand, dear» friends, «stand; sit down, dear» friends, «sit down,» when there are «fewer than ten it is not proper conduct» to speak in such a dignified style.
